content: <thought>We need to identify which of the returned templates correctly retrosynthesizes the target molecule “COc1ccccc1Nc1cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc([N+](=O)[O-])c1O” into the two precursors that were previously listed: “COc1ccccc1N” and “Nc1cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc([N+](=O)[O-])c1O”. I will test each candidate template (using their reaction_id as the template_id) with the apply_template tool and check which one yields exactly those two precursors. Once identified, I will return its mapped_rxn and template_id.
